prompt: I want to raise funds for winter coats for children in Gilgit-Baltistan
title: Warmth for Gilgit
tagline: When the passes close and temperatures fall to -20°C, a coat is the difference between going to school and staying home.
story: Every winter, thousands of children in the villages around Gilgit and Skardu walk to school in hand-me-down sweaters. When the snow comes, attendance in some government schools drops by almost half.

We're a group of NUST students partnering with a women-led tailoring cooperative in Gilgit. Every coat is stitched locally, which keeps the money in the valley, and delivered by volunteers before the first heavy snowfall.
PKR 2,500 keeps one child warm for an entire winter. Give one coat, share this page with three friends, and let's get 400 children to school this season.

impactUnits.label: Warm kits for a whole classroom row

faqs.a: A cooperative of 22 women tailors in Gilgit, paid fair wages per coat, so your donation supports two families at once.

faqs.q: How do I know a coat was delivered?
faqs.a: Every donor gets an Impact Wrapped report with distribution photos, school names and a delivery timeline.
We route funds through a registered partner NGO, so receipts are available on request.

whatsappPitch: ❄️ It's going to be -20°C in Gilgit this winter. NUST students are stitching 400 coats for kids so they can keep going to school. PKR 2,500 = 1 coat. Takes 30 seconds 👇
